vendor.blurb: Superintelligence Labs rebuilt on Muse: Spark back at the frontier, image and video top 10

muse-spark-1-3.tagline: Meta's cheapest ticket back to the frontier
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 48 (max), above Grok 4.7's 46
Code Arena #10 (1656), Text Arena #9 (1494)
Meta reports DeepSWE v1.1 75.4%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 88.8%
About 20% fewer tool calls and 25% fewer tokens than 1.2
muse-spark-1-3.notes: Reasoning tiers go up to xhigh/max; the low-price Contributor tier retains data for training. Reportedly gamed Terminal Bench Science by exploiting a Lean kernel bug; math proofs get mixed reviews.

muse-spark-1-2.tagline: The chat-first Muse, #7 on Text Arena
highlights: Text Arena 1496, #7, Meta's best text score
Code Arena only 1531 (#40), well behind 1.3 at coding
Zuckerberg and Alexandr Wang promised to open the weights
muse-spark-1-2.notes: Launched the same day as the terminal coding agent Muse Code; the open-weights pledge was still unfulfilled as of early September. Third-party tier lists put it in tier C.

muse-spark-1-1.tagline: The first Muse MSL shipped for real
highlights: Muse Spark announced April 8; 1.1 is the first official release
Text Arena 1491 (#12); original muse-spark 1489 (#13)
Code Arena 1541 (#35)
muse-spark-1-1.notes: Folds in the original April Muse Spark; superseded by 1.2 and 1.3.

muse-glimmer.tagline: Meta's open model that fits on one 24GB GPU
highlights: Apache 2.0 open weights; under 20GB at 4-bit quantization
Runs offline on a single 24GB consumer GPU; 100+ languages
AA Intelligence Index 17, Text Arena 1424 (#118)
muse-glimmer.notes: Marks Meta's return to open source after Llama; accepts text and image input.

llama-4-maverick.tagline: The last mainstay of the Llama line
highlights: AA Intelligence Index 10; same-gen Scout scores 8 (10M context)
Still one of the most widely deployed Meta open-weights models
Meta has since moved to Muse; Llama hasn't been updated
llama-4-maverick.notes: Included as a historical reference; folds in Scout (109B total/17B active, 10M context).

muse-image.tagline: A top-10 painter at a cent an image
highlights: AA text-to-image #7 (Elo 1111), Arena text-to-image #7 (1276)
$10 per 1,000 images, cheapest in the top 10
Live in Meta AI, Instagram Stories and WhatsApp
muse-image.notes: MSL's first image model; sparked controversy after launch over its use of user photos.

muse-video.tagline: All leaderboard, no API: a trailer for now
highlights: Arena text-to-video #9 (1456), ahead of Sora 2 Pro and Veo 3.1
Same pretraining base as Muse Image, with native audio
July preview, still just "coming soon": no API, no pricing
muse-video.notes: The released field is the preview date; resolution and duration undisclosed; not on the AA video leaderboard.
